environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EKS behind an AWS ALB with standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate requirement). Service is exposed via Ingress with path /api/v2/* routed to the pod on port 3000. No network policy restricting ingress sources. ALB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443.

config.tls: ACM certificate on ALB, TLS 1.2 minimum, no mutual TLS
